texts.preamble: Dr. Nitin Hiralal Shimpi vs The State Of Maharashtra Through The ... on 29 May, 2023 Bench: R. D. Dhanuka, G.S.Kulkarni 2023:Bhc-As:14451-Db Kvm 1/6 2 - Wp 6424 Of 2023.d In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Civil Appellate Jurisdiction Writ Petition No. 6424 Of 2023 Dr.Nitin Hiralal Shimpi ..... Petitioner Versus The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ..... Respondents Coram: R. D. Dhanuka , Cj And G.S.Kulkarni, Jj. Date : 29Th May, 2023 (Vacation Court) P.C:- Rule.
texts.facts: Petitioner intends to apply for the post of Food Safety Officer and Assistant Commissioner of Food pursuant to the advertisement published by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission, Respondent No.2 (for short "M.P.S.C.") dated 24th February, 2023 and appear at the Maharashtra Civil Services Combined Preliminary Examination, 2023 to be held on 4th June, 2023. The Petitioner holds the degree of BHMS from a recognized university. It is the case of the Petitioner that Homeopathy is one of the forms/branches of the medicine and is a medical system that was developed in Germany more than 200 years ago. The definition of Medicine under Section 2(f) cannot be made applicable when the word 'medicine' as a whole is understood. Apart from Allopathy, there can be other branches of medicine by which the patients are cured and are recognized by the Medical Council of India, i.e. Unani, Ayurveda, Allopathy and Siddha.
texts.arguments: The relevant paragraphs of the said judgment recognizing the said qualification possessed by the Petitioner reads as under :- " 5. The Medical Council Act of 1956 has defined Medicine under Section 2(f) as follows :- (f) "Medicine" means modern scientific KVM 2 - WP 6424 OF 2023.doc medicine in all its branches and include surgery and obstetrics, but does not include veterinary medicine and surgery." We have also perused the order dated 2nd May, 2023 in Writ Petition No. 5970 of 2023 in case of Ratnadip Nanasaheb Bhise & Ors. vs. Maharashtra Public Service Commission & Ors. as referred by the Tribunal, wherein the Division Bench of this Court has dealt with the issue equivalent to the Degree in Pharmacy and decided the issue as to whether the said degree equivalent to the degree mentioned in clause 2.1.3. 6.
